guess_property_metadata: guess metadata for all properties in a list of ASE atoms objects including info and calculator results
guess_target_metadata: guess whether a target property is per-atom or per-image and if it is intensive or extensive
check_target_extensive: check if a target property scales extensively with atom count using statistical normalization
check_target_per_atom: check if a target property has a first dimension proportional to the number of atoms
check_uniform_atoms_lengths: check if all structures in a dataset have the same number of atoms
